messages:
Alex R: Quick kickoff for Nimbus pilot onboarding tomorrow 10am PT. Maya, Jorge, Priya, Sam, Liam, Devin  can we confirm owners, success criteria, and blockers? I'll paste a short runbook below.

Maya C: I can own CS ops + weekly cadence. Setting a recurring 30m Wed standup (invite in 10m).

Jorge L: I'll own integration/infra. Blockers: SSO (SAML) + audit logs to their SIEM, and proof of EU data residency requested. ETA: SSO by next Tue if we get certs today.

Sam T: For SSO I need their metadata + a test user. I can spin up a test env on dev-dedicated. Also want to confirm model variant  Nimbus prefers int8 quantized for cost.

Priya S: CS success criteria from PM: 1) E2E SSO sign-in, 2) p95 latency <= 200ms on sample flows, 3) process first 5k monthly tokens without errors. Renewal risk: if not live in 45 days -> medium. I'll own renewal milestones and escalation.

Liam K: Enablement plan: 2x60m sessions (Dev deep-dive + Product demo). Proposed: Tue 4/18 11am PT (dev) and Thu 4/20 2pm PT (product). Confirm or propose alt.

Devin P: Security/legal asks: SOC2 evidence, KMS integration proof, DPA + SSO assertion example. Starting the security questionnaire now. Need customer legal contact. Link: https://redwood-infra.example.com/sec-q/12345

OnboardBot: New ticket created: CS-4821 - Nimbus onboarding runbook (https://tracker.redwood.dev/CS-4821) assigned to Maya C, Jorge L, Priya S.

Alex R: Action list: Sam -> SSO doc + test creds by EOD; Jorge -> cert exchange owner; Maya -> invite + kickoff agenda; Devin -> sec questionnaire + legal contact; Priya -> renewal milestones & NRR signals. I'll follow up after first sync. :rocket:

Maya C: Agenda draft: 1) Intros 2) Success criteria & risks 3) Tech checklist 4) Timeline & milestones 5) Enablement plan 6) Feedback loop. Comment please.

Jorge L: Also need customer's IP ranges for firewall pre-approval. Can someone ask them in the pre-meeting?

Priya S: I'll add renewal milestones to Notion and tag product usage KPIs. Request: capture 3 sample prompts from their dev team for quality monitoring.

Sam T: Quick test command for SSO probe I use: curl -X GET 'https://nimbus.example.com/auth/test' -H 'Authorization: SAML <token>'  I'll share exact steps in a doc.

Sam T: Tagging @jess-devops  can you confirm GPU pool availability for pilot week of 4/24?

Jess (external): Confirmed  reserved gpu-pool-dedicated-1 for 4/24-4/30. :white_check_mark:

Alex R: Treat first two weeks as an "integration window" with daily async check-ins in this thread for blockers. If something blocks SLA flag it here and we'll escalate. :eyes:

Devin P: FYI legal asked for sample DPA + SSO assertion. I'll attach to CS-4821 when ready.

Maya C: Sending calendar invites + pre-meeting checklist (ask for metadata, IP ranges, test user, and 3 sample prompts). See you tomorrow. :handshake:
